lines.trans: Here is dessert from our pastry chef.
Thank you for changing the menu for me.
I am the chef and I fulfill any orders.
And what do you do, if it is not a secret?
I work as a judge at the Tverskoy court.
Whoa! And they suspended my license yesterday!
What is your last name?
My last name is Barinov. Viktor Barinov.
So it was I who issued that decision!
Maybe we can fix everything?
No. You knocked down a traffic light on the road!
But I had a valid excuse.
Say thank you that the suspension is only a year.

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?
All right, here you go. There, look.
They will give only eight years.

examples.text: Предлагаю чистосердечное признание. Дадут всего восемь лет.
examples.trans: I suggest a full confession. They'll give you only eight years.

meanings.note: ends a conversation or an order: 'Всё, свободен' = that's all, you can go
at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.note: Core Russian adv meaning 'yesterday' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Я вчера ел маринованные грибы. Может, один гриб был плохой.
examples.trans: Yesterday I ate pickled mushrooms. Maybe one mushroom was bad.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.en: to hand down, to issue, to deliver
meanings.note: pronouncing a legal ruling or carrying outside

examples.trans: The judge handed down a strict decision.

examples.text: Так это я вынесла такое решение!
examples.trans: So it was I who issued that decision!
We will carry her out at night.

выполнять.gloss: to perform, to carry out, to do (an exercise)

meanings.en: to perform, to execute, to carry out (an exercise, task, or order)
meanings.note: Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'полнять'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to perform, to carry out, to do (an exercise)', paired with 'выполнить'.

examples.trans: Girls, don't sleep, do the exercise!
He always completes his work on time.

examples.text: Девочки, не спим, выполняем! Раз, и два, и три.
examples.trans: Girls, don't sleep, do the exercise! One, and two, and three.

meanings.note: after 2, 3, 4: года; after 5 and more: лет

examples.trans: I've been working here for four years.

examples.text: Это было давно, тридцать лет назад.
examples.trans: That was long ago, thirty years back.

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been working as mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: Borrowed from French 'dessert' (from 'desservir', to clear the table).

examples.trans: We could open a salon for you.

examples.text: Для вас можно открыть салон красоты.
examples.trans: We could open a beauty salon for you.

examples.text: Какая разница, кто будет строить дороги?
examples.trans: What does it matter who builds the roads?

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?

examples.text: Я делаю всё точно по вашему заказу.
examples.trans: I do everything exactly according to your order.
In the kitchen they are preparing this order.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

изменить.gloss: to cheat on, to betray; to change

meanings.en: to cheat on, to be unfaithful to

examples.trans: Edik, I wanted to cheat on you.

examples.text: Эдик, я хотела тебе изменить. С ним, чтобы отомстить.
examples.trans: Edik, I wanted to cheat on you. With him, to take revenge.

meanings.en: to fix, to correct, to put right
meanings.note: Prefix 'ис-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'править'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to fix, to correct', paired with 'исправлять'.

examples.trans: Excuse us, we will fix everything.

examples.text: Ученик быстро исправил ошибку в тетради.
examples.trans: The pupil quickly corrected the mistake in his notebook.

examples.text: Да, вы знаете, это очень серьёзная операция. Мы всё исправим. До свидания!
examples.trans: Yes, you know, it is a very serious operation. We'll fix everything. Goodbye!

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: baker specializing in sweets and desserts

examples.trans: Our pastry chef made a cake.
Here is dessert from our pastry chef.

examples.text: Я пришёл к нашему кондитеру Луи!
examples.trans: I arrived at our pastry chef Louis's place!
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

meanings.en: to deprive, to strip of, to revoke
meanings.note: depriving someone of rights or property

examples.text: Ого! А меня вчера лишили прав!
examples.trans: Whoa! And they suspended my license yesterday!

meanings.note: в любой момент = at any moment

examples.text: Любая обезьяна эти выборы выиграет! Ты что, хуже обезьяны?
examples.trans: Any monkey will win this election! What, are you worse than a monkey?

meanings.note: on a phone or in a restaurant; indeclinable

examples.text: Что за меню здесь? Как позвонить?
examples.trans: What's this menu here? How do I make a call?

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.
Wow, a tape recorder! A Japanese one!

meanings.note: reason offered to explain or excuse conduct

examples.trans: There is no excuse for this action.

examples.text: Но у меня было уважительное оправдание.
examples.trans: But I had a valid excuse.
Enough excuses, quickly go to work!

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.
She had a right to the flat.

examples.text: Моя мама имела право на квартиру. Она пенсионерка.
examples.trans: My mother had a right to the flat. She is a pensioner.

meanings.note: работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been working as mayor for four years now.
I am forced to cancel my decision.
We have already made a decision.

meanings.en: to knock down, to hit, to strike
meanings.note: causing an object to fall by collision

examples.trans: The driver knocked down a road sign.

examples.text: Нет. Вы сбили светофор на дороге!
examples.trans: No. You knocked down a traffic light on the road!
The traffic light is on at the crossroads.

examples.text: Нет. Вы сбили светофор на дороге!
examples.trans: No. You knocked down a traffic light on the road!

meanings.note: Borrowed via French 'secret' from Latin 'secretum' (something set apart or hidden).

examples.trans: These are our little men's secrets!

examples.text: А вы кем работаете, если не секрет?
examples.trans: And what do you do, if it is not a secret?

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'court' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Суд решил: домашний арест по месту прописки.
examples.trans: The court has decided: house arrest at his registered address.

meanings.note: in a court of law or a referee in sport

examples.trans: Wait. And who is the judge?

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

meanings.note: 'что я за мэр такой' = what kind of mayor am I
relating to the city or district of Tver

examples.trans: She works at the Tverskoy court.

examples.text: Я работаю судьёй в Тверском суде.
examples.trans: I work as a judge at the Tverskoy court.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: excuse accepted by authority or showing respect

examples.text: Но у меня было уважительное оправдание.
examples.trans: But I had a valid excuse.

meanings.note: noun of the first declension ending in -ия

examples.trans: Here, I found her surname: Pylinkina.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

examples.trans: The chef is in the kitchen.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
